tools.name: quotapath_list_deals
tools.description: List deals in the QuotaPath workspace. Filter by id, integration_id (your system's id), path_id or user_email (deal owner). Uses GET /v1/deal/.

tools.name: quotapath_get_deal
tools.description: Get one deal by uuid, with its deal values, metadata and state. Uses GET /v1/deal/{uuid}/.

tools.name: quotapath_create_deal
tools.description: Create one deal in QuotaPath, with its owner, amounts per path and state. This changes commission data: confirm the owner, path ids and amounts first. Uses POST /v1/deal/.

tools.name: quotapath_bulk_create_deals
tools.description: Create many deals in one call. Each item uses the same fields as quotapath_create_deal. This changes commission data. Uses POST /v1/deal/bulk/.

tools.name: quotapath_update_deal
tools.description: Change some fields of one deal. Send only the fields to change; the others stay as they are. Uses PATCH /v1/deal/{uuid}/.

tools.name: quotapath_delete_deal
tools.description: Remove one deal from QuotaPath. This cannot be undone through this server. Check the deal with quotapath_get_deal first, and get the user's OK. Uses DELETE /v1/deal/{uuid}/.

tools.name: quotapath_list_payouts
tools.description: List all payouts, resolved and unresolved. Use updated_since to fetch only changes since a Unix time in seconds. Uses GET /v1/payout/.

tools.name: quotapath_list_resolved_payouts
tools.description: List resolved payouts, the ones that can go to your external software systems. Use updated_since to fetch only changes. Uses GET /v1/payout/resolved/.

tools.name: quotapath_list_unresolved_payouts
tools.description: List payouts that are not resolved yet. Uses GET /v1/payout/unresolved/.

tools.name: quotapath_list_plans
tools.description: List compensation plans with their assignments and paths. Path uuids from here go into deal values. Uses GET /v1/plan/.

tools.name: quotapath_list_teams
tools.description: List teams in the QuotaPath workspace with their current members and managers. Uses GET /v1/team/.

tools.name: quotapath_list_users
tools.description: List users in the QuotaPath workspace (name and email). Use the email as user_email on a deal. Uses GET /v1/user/.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quotapath_list_users · Public sink: quotapath_create_deal, quotapath_bulk_create_deals, quotapath_update_deal, quotapath_list_users · Destructive: quotapath_delete_deal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quotapath_list_users · Public sink: quotapath_create_deal, quotapath_bulk_create_deals, quotapath_update_deal, quotapath_list_users · Destructive: quotapath_delete_deal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
